# fideslang-tools

> Rust CLI for Fideslang privacy taxonomies and Fides manifests. Browse, validate, merge, convert and graph data maps offline.

The binary is `fl`; the crate on crates.io is `fideslang-cli` (the crate named `fl` is an unrelated tool). It is a single static binary with the IAB Tech Lab Privacy Taxonomy (fideslang 3.0.0: 85 data categories, 55 data uses, 15 data subjects) compiled in. It needs no Python, no Fides server and no network, and it collects no telemetry. MIT-licensed code; the vendored taxonomy is CC BY 4.0.

Install:

- Homebrew (macOS, Linux): `brew install noru-tech/tap/fl`
- Prebuilt binary via cargo: `cargo binstall fideslang-cli`
- From source (Rust 1.89+): `cargo install --locked fideslang-cli`

Common commands: `fl taxonomy show user.contact.email`, `fl taxonomy search cookie`, `fl taxonomy tree categories --depth 2`, `fl validate .fides/`, `fl graph .fides/ --format mermaid`, `fl convert datamap.yml --to json`, `fl merge .fides/ -o all.yml`, `fl stats .fides/`. Manifest commands default to `./.fides/` when no path is given.

`fl validate` reports findings with stable codes (E001-E007 errors, W001-W005 warnings) and exits 0 (clean or warnings only), 1 (at least one error) or 2 (usage, input or I/O error). `--format json` (with `schema_version` and a `help_uri` per finding), `yaml`, `github` (Actions annotations) and `sarif` (SARIF 2.1.0 for code scanning) give machine-readable output.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/noru-tech/fideslang-tools/blob/main/README.md): what fl does, install, quick start, command reference
- [How do I validate a Fides manifest offline?](https://github.com/noru-tech/fideslang-tools/blob/main/README.md#how-do-i-validate-a-fides-manifest-offline): `fl validate` walkthrough with real output
- [How do I draw a data map from Fides manifests?](https://github.com/noru-tech/fideslang-tools/blob/main/README.md#how-do-i-draw-a-data-map-from-fides-manifests): `fl graph` as DOT, Mermaid or JSON
- [Validation rules](https://github.com/noru-tech/fideslang-tools/blob/main/docs/rules/README.md): index of every E0xx/W0xx code, with one page per code (rule, why, failing and passing example, fix, suppression)
- [Exit codes](https://github.com/noru-tech/fideslang-tools/blob/main/docs/exit-codes.md): 0 success, 1 findings, 2 error
- [Output formats and exit codes](https://github.com/noru-tech/fideslang-tools/blob/main/README.md#output-formats-and-exit-codes): `--format` values per command and global flags
- [What it is not, and known limitations](https://github.com/noru-tech/fideslang-tools/blob/main/README.md#what-it-is-not-and-known-limitations): not a Fides client, not a compliance verdict, one taxonomy version per build
